requirements_and_architecture.description: Issue #303 records the seven-primitives architecture, typed receipt interfaces, assertions/non-effects and fail-closed requirements before the Core implementation merge; repository evidence does not by itself identify the natural-person creative author of those choices.

source_code_expression.description: Git history establishes origin and continuity of the selected source file but does not establish which natural person personally created the protected source-code expression.

selection_editing_integration.description: Private working history or a natural-person declaration is required to distinguish creative human selection/editing/integration from technical approval or repository merge activity.

debugging_testing_choices.description: The repository records conformance and fail-closed tests, but current public evidence does not attribute creative debugging/testing choices to a verified natural person.

coauthor_and_third_party.notes: The selected validator directly imports only Node.js built-in crypto, fs and path. That narrows dependency risk but does not prove source-expression authorship or exclude copied/adapted/generated expression.

unresolved_items: Obtain a private natural-person creative-contribution declaration for the selected source scope.

Resolve employment-duty, commissioning and assignment allocation for the creation period.
Resolve any coauthor or contributor contribution touching the selected deposit scope.
Complete source-origin clearance beyond direct runtime dependency review.
